# Wishes into the Physical Media Universe

> A fan-made tracker of every physical media wish made on Physical Therapy: A Movie Podcast (PT Movie Pod), and whether each has come true.

Physical Therapy: A Movie Podcast is a movie podcast dedicated to physical media, film preservation and why owning movies matters. It is hosted by Kurt and Sam, produced by Kimberly, and covers 4K UHD and Blu-ray releases and boutique labels such as Arrow Video, Criterion, Kino Lorber and Shout Factory. Each episode ends with the hosts wishing for a film to be released on a format it is not yet available on.

This site lists 230 wishes from 91 episodes; 35 have come true. Release status was last checked on 2026-10-13.

## Links

- [The wish list](https://tjsander.github.io/ptmoviepod-wishes/): the full table with outcomes and release links
- [Data as JSON](https://tjsander.github.io/ptmoviepod-wishes/data.json): every wish with film, format, wisher, episode and release status
- [Listen to the podcast](https://linktr.ee/ptmoviepod): all platforms
- [Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/physical-therapy-a-movie-podcast/id1736079773)
